def smd.isAtomOpt_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Atom) (oA : Option smd.Atom),
    smd.isAtomOpt a oA ⊢ □ smd.isAtomOpt a oA

def smd.isAtomOpt_list.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Atom) (e : smd.TypeRef) (rel : smd.ElemRel) (ks : List GoString),
    smd.isAtomOpt a (some (smd.Atom.list e rel ks)) ⊣⊢ ⌜a.Scalar' = null ∧ a.Map' = null⌝ ∗ smd.isListRep a.List' e rel ks

def smd.Schema.WF_fields_nodup.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (n : GoString) (fs : List (GoString × smd.TypeRef)) (e : Option smd.TypeRef) (rel : smd.ElemRel),
    S.WF → S.find n = some (smd.Atom.map fs e rel) → (List.map (fun x => x.fst) fs).Nodup

def smd.isTypeRef_elim.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (tr : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.TypeRef) (t : smd.TypeRef),
    smd.isTypeRef tr t ⊢
      typedPointsto tr.NamedType' t.name DFrac.discard ∗
        ⌜tr.Inlined' = zero_val sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Atom ∧
            tr.ElementRelationship' = null ∧ tr.Nullable' = t.nullable⌝

def smd.isListRep_elim.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (l : Loc) (e : smd.TypeRef) (rel : smd.ElemRel) (ks : List GoString),
    smd.isListRep l e rel ks ⊢
      ∃ v ksl,
        typedPointsto l v DFrac.discard ∗
          ⌜v.ElementRelationship' = rel.goName ∧ v.Keys' = ksl⌝ ∗
            ownSlice ksl ks DFrac.discard ∗ smd.isTypeRef v.ElementType' e

def smd.isAtomOpt_none.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Atom),
    smd.isAtomOpt a none ⊣⊢ ⌜a = zero_val sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Atom⌝

def smd.isAtomOpt_map.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Atom) (fs : List (GoString × smd.TypeRef)) (e : Option smd.TypeRef)
    (rel : smd.ElemRel),
    smd.isAtomOpt a (some (smd.Atom.map fs e rel)) ⊣⊢ ⌜a.Scalar' = null ∧ a.List' = null⌝ ∗ smd.isMapRep a.Map' fs e rel

def smd.isMapRep_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : Loc) (fs : List (GoString × smd.TypeRef)) (e : Option smd.TypeRef) (rel : smd.ElemRel),
    smd.isMapRep m fs e rel ⊢ □ smd.isMapRep m fs e rel

def smd.isMapRep_elim.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : Loc) (fs : List (GoString × smd.TypeRef)) (e : Option smd.TypeRef) (rel : smd.ElemRel),
    smd.isMapRep m fs e rel ⊢
      ∃ fsl sfs etv,
        typedPointsto
            (structFieldRef sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Map go!"Fields" m)
            fsl DFrac.discard ∗
          ownSlice fsl sfs DFrac.discard ∗
            ⌜sfs.length = fs.length⌝ ∗
              (□ ∀ i sf f, ⌜sfs[i]? = some sf ∧ fs[i]? = some f⌝ -∗ smd.isStructField sf f) ∗
                typedPointsto
                    (structFieldRef sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Map
                      go!"Unions" m)
                    slice.nil DFrac.discard ∗
                  typedPointsto
                      (structFieldRef sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Map
                        go!"ElementType" m)
                      etv DFrac.discard ∗
                    smd.isTypeRefOpt etv e ∗
                      typedPointsto
                        (structFieldRef sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Map
                          go!"ElementRelationship"
                          m)
                        rel.goName DFrac.discard

def smd.isListRep_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (l : Loc) (e : smd.TypeRef) (rel : smd.ElemRel) (ks : List GoString),
    smd.isListRep l e rel ks ⊢ □ smd.isListRep l e rel ks

def smd.isTypeRefOpt_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (tr : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.TypeRef) (ot : Option smd.TypeRef),
    smd.isTypeRefOpt tr ot ⊢ □ smd.isTypeRefOpt tr ot

def smd.isTypeRefOpt_none.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (tr : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.TypeRef),
    smd.isTypeRefOpt tr none ⊣⊢ ⌜tr = zero_val sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.TypeRef⌝

def smd.isTypeRefOpt_some.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (tr : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.TypeRef) (t : smd.TypeRef),
    smd.isTypeRefOpt tr (some t) ⊣⊢ smd.isTypeRef tr t

def smd.isStructField_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (sf : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.StructField) (f : GoString × smd.TypeRef),
    smd.isStructField sf f ⊢ □ smd.isStructField sf f

def smd.Schema.WF_types_nodup.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema), S.WF → (List.map (fun x => x.fst) S.types).Nodup

def smd.isStructField_elim.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (sf : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.StructField) (f : GoString × smd.TypeRef),
    smd.isStructField sf f ⊣⊢ ⌜sf.Name' = f.fst ∧ sf.Default' = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗ smd.isTypeRef sf.Type' f.snd

def smd.isAtomOpt_scalar.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.schema.Atom) (s : smd.Scalar),
    smd.isAtomOpt a (some (smd.Atom.scalar s)) ⊣⊢
      typedPointsto a.Scalar' s.goName DFrac.discard ∗ ⌜a.List' = null ∧ a.Map' = null⌝
